versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the KPI Tracker Skill.
- Track, categorize, and set targets for multiple business KPIs.
- Record and store KPI data in JSON for historical analysis.
- Generate weekly/monthly KPI reports in markdown, with visual status indicators.
- Automatic flagging of off-track KPIs and root cause prompts.
- Summarize trends and forecast target achievement using historical data.
- Easy setup with sample config, and support for scheduled report generation.
